top_signals.title: Bonds Selloff Pushes 10-Year Treasury Yield Closer to 5%
top_signals.summary: Bond bears are pushing benchmark Treasury yields toward the closely-watched 5% level ahead of US inflation data that stands to determine expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next week. Bloomberg MLIV's David Savage reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: India-China Set For Bilateral Talks At BRICS Summit
top_signals.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping will visit India this weekend to attend the BRICS summit, marking his first trip to the country since 2019. But Observer Research Foundation's Antara Ghosal Singh says while progress has been made on the India-China border issues, economic ties between both sides remain challenging. She spoke with Bloomberg's Insight with Haslinda Amin.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Visitor levy in England
top_signals.summary: This consultation seeks views on the design of a new Mayoral power to create visitor levies on overnight stays in England.
